test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an example of application software?
solution:
The correct answer is __**A word processor**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **A word processor** is an example of application software.
 
• Application software is designed to help users perform specific tasks or activities on a computer.
 
• Examples of application software include word processors, spreadsheets, database management system
